R10 the earlier approved version becomes updated, naming its successor, and stays offered; widen makes a project template group-wide, by an administrator, changing no version
R11 retiring a whole template: by an approver of its scope, with a reason; none of its versions is offered, each stays readable with the reason, no new version is drafted; nothing deleted
R11 withdrawing a draft or in-review version: by its author, with a reason; an approved or updated version is never withdrawn alone
